author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before drew four pointed arches over a boxed base, reading as a fist or a crown; redrawn like the reference: four round finger rings in an arch (outer rings lower, each touching its neighbour), posts down to a rounded grip bar, and an open palm gap between rings and bar.
omissions: Reference's fifth side ring and the raised ridge inside the grip omitted (width/8-unit budget); rings are r5 so neighbours touch at lattice points.
